faq.title: The questions we get asked.
faq.a1: A TV (or a screen, or a projector) and a computer with a browser. Nothing else.
faq.q2: Do my customers need to install an app?
faq.a2: No. They scan the QR code on the TV and it opens right in their browser.
faq.q3: How many players at the same time?
faq.a3: From 2 to 200 depending on the game. The blind test is unlimited: the whole room can play.
faq.a4: A standard connection is enough. Players use their own 4G/5G or your WiFi.
faq.q5: Can I stop whenever I want?
faq.a5: Yes, cancel in 1 click from your account. No notice period, no fees.
faq.q6: What kind of venue does it work for?
faq.a6: Bars, breweries, bowling alleys, campsites, casinos, event venues… and even airports.
faq.moreLead: Want to go further? Everything is explained in detail in our guide.
